scope: Reconcile all 33 CP321 dependency contracts against CP331 normalized transition anchors and CP332 provider/consumer records; add four explicitly reread live and T/F handoff contracts. This is a bounded semantic review of dependency contracts, not exhaustive independent statement-by-statement revalidation of all transitions.
method: Read CP321 source-reviewed dependency contracts and normalized anchors; compare qualifications against prior source review CP322–332. Reopen current source for S shared revision and dirty frontier, Order_B feedback signature and restoration, E main index and independent roots, StopAll donor/freeze, Primary gates/scheduler/reflection/dirty, T/F repair and display, Bridge feedback and active live entry, Live transport. Source ranges are overlap cross-links, not exact equivalence or evidence of dynamic invocation. Uncovered intervals are candidate review locations, not confirmed semantic gaps. Existing transition inventories and historical specifications unchanged.
documentation_traceability: CP323 chronology document is qualification/linked evidence, not 73 literal record headings; CP324–330 each contain all their row IDs. Existing source references remain pinned.

additional_handoffs.name: Serialized output to T/F per segment
additional_handoffs.meaning: Reversal output replaces direction groups only if transition index<=market.end_index. Apply T/F to each calculationSegments entry or group itself, not both. Final sourceTime winner priority directional primary, StopAll, E, S using first valid occurrence. Clears previous verdict metadata even for invalid candidates; no native geometry mutation.

additional_handoffs.name: T/F repair and open confirmation cutoff
additional_handoffs.meaning: Repair through selected main open + timeframe -1 second; inclusive lower search end, inclusive start; strict own-direction crossing with Decimal level. StopAll closure uses decisionTime + timeframe <= min(epoch(through)+1,last lower timestamp epoch+raw_timeframe). Repeated prefix relabel only on closure callback or absent callback; distinct Basic repeat/verdict/base counters.

additional_handoffs.name: Live lineage to active replay
additional_handoffs.meaning: Selected precision must match original slice; catch-up then strictly increasing appended times. Prefix hash/delta proof checked before pipeline append; lineage updates after success. Delta mismatch or raw digest mismatch emits retry errors without advancing; RAW change terminates. Active worker replays all trading stages without optional live= argument, using conditional retained market views and staged closed-regime cache.

additional_handoffs.name: Live scope and public output boundary
additional_handoffs.meaning: Public main loads engines and executes market context + pipeline + response in calculation scope, encodes only after leaving it; worker emits separate progress and seed/update messages. No implicit live continuation argument in either active pipeline call; protocol availability is not evidence of active use. Exceptions produce error payload and nonzero status.

remaining.detail: Review every queued transition and all relevant cross-owner handoff/callback sites not represented by the historical dependency matrix. Determine semantic disposition from actual source; do not treat overlap or lack of overlap as correctness.

Validate full transition/specification correspondence including CP323 partial and reconciliation rows, CP322 call semantics and CP332 provider/consumer groups. Cross-check active/historical chronology clauses, implicit ownership and failure/replay boundaries; reconcile any contradictory or missing rules.
Reassess closure after bounded reviews, then separately W3 forensic source-first review and W4 gates. W2 remains IN_PROGRESS.

limitations: 33/33 is a known historical-contract denominator only, not W2 completion. Source-anchor overlaps are traceability only; some prior source-reviewed contracts are reused with qualifications rather than newly independently reviewed in entirety.
No complete dynamic dispatch or execution proof; no RAW, runtime, ZIP or production changes.
